question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
-- Compute runs conceded and wickets per bowler, return only the bowler with the lowest average
WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(bats.runs_scored) AS runs_off_bat
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bats ON b.match_id = bats.match_id AND b.over_id = bats.over_id AND b.ball_id = bats.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bats.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_extras AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(e.extra_runs) AS extras_charged
    FROM extra_runs e
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON e.match_id = b.match_id AND e.over_id = b.over_id AND e.ball_id = b.ball_id AND e.innings_no = b.innings_no
    WHERE e.extra_type IN ('wides', 'noballs', 'penalty')
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) AS wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COALESCE(br.runs_off_bat, 0) + COALESCE(be.extras_charged, 0) AS total_runs_conceded,
    bw.wickets,
    1.0 * (COALESCE(br.runs_off_bat, 0) + COALESCE(be.extras_charged, 0)) / bw.wickets AS bowling_average
FROM bowler_wickets bw
JOIN bowler_runs br ON bw.bowler = br.bowler
LEFT JOIN bowler_extras be ON bw.bowler = be.bowler
JOIN player p ON bw.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;
